projects.title: Digital Banking & Cards Platform
projects.summary: Modern banking platform focused on credit/debit card management and digital wallet integrations.
highlights: Developing scalable backend systems for card provisioning, lifecycle management, and digital wallet setups.
Architecting event-driven microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and Kafka for secure, high-throughput financial transactions.
Ensuring strict compliance with banking security standards and data protection protocols.

projects.title: Airline Search & Ticketing Platform
projects.summary: Comprehensive flight search, booking, and ticketing system for airline operations.
highlights: Engineered the core booking and ticketing engine for a major airline client.
Integrated the Sabre Global Distribution System (GDS) API for real-time flight search and reservations.
Built scalable backend services using Java and Spring Boot to handle high-volume transaction processing.

projects.title: Enterprise Health Insurance Suite
projects.summary: A comprehensive health insurance platform comprising an enrollment system, member portal, and customer service admin dashboard.

Designed and built responsive user interfaces for members and admins using React.js and Material UI.

hobbyProjects.title: Encrypto
hobbyProjects.summary: A user-friendly file security app designed to protect sensitive data with offline, state-of-the-art AES-CBC encryption.
highlights: Built with React Native, node-forge, and SQLite.
Supports 16KB memory page sizes for up to 30% faster encryption on modern Android devices.
100% offline, lightweight, and features a minimalistic design with biometric authentication.

hobbyProjects.title: PaisaTrackr
hobbyProjects.summary: A simple, intuitive personal finance app to track expenses, manage multiple accounts, and stick to your budget.
highlights: Built with React Native, Redux Toolkit, and SQLite.
Features multiple account management, custom budget alerts, and in-depth reports.
Minimalistic, user-friendly, and offline-first currency-free design.

hobbyProjects.title: TriMorris
hobbyProjects.summary: A beautifully crafted modern adaptation of the ancient Three Men's Morris game, offering strategic gameplay against friends or a smart AI.
highlights: Built with React Native, TypeScript, and Redux Toolkit.
Features local multiplayer, a smart AI opponent, and an interactive tutorial.
Ad-free, offline-first experience with beautiful retro graphics and smooth animations.

hobbyProjects.title: Whistory
hobbyProjects.summary: A fast, privacy-focused web application to view and analyze exported WhatsApp chat backups entirely locally in the browser.
highlights: Built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS for a responsive and modern interface.
Processes and parses WhatsApp chat .zip exports directly on the client using zip.js, ensuring user data never leaves the device.
Features high-performance virtualized lists to seamlessly render thousands of messages, alongside advanced search and date filtering capabilities.

hobbyProjects.title: Insta Intruder
hobbyProjects.summary: A simple client-side web app that compares your Instagram followers vs followings to identify users who don't follow you back.
highlights: Runs 100% client-side—no backend required, ensuring your exported data remains completely private.
Automatically parses Instagram's 'Your Information' JSON exports to compute list differences.
Features a clean, modern UI built with React Hooks and Tailwind CSS, complete with file validation.
